title: Build a configuration that survives contact with production data
description: Choose a prediction job, an input profile, and a split strategy. The lab checks leakage, serving parity, and whether the evaluation split matches the way examples repeat over time.

featureProfiles.label: Small baseline
featureProfiles.detail: Use the first two request-time fields to establish a simple, reproducible reference.

featureProfiles.label: Production inputs
featureProfiles.detail: Use every field that is available at prediction time, but exclude post-outcome and offline-only fields.

featureProfiles.label: Every dataset column
featureProfiles.detail: Pass every non-target column into the model, including fields that may leak or disappear at serving time.

splits.label: Random rows
splits.detail: Let rows from the same account or future period land in different partitions.

splits.label: Fixed, group-aware
splits.detail: Create a split column upstream so one account or entity stays in exactly one partition.

splits.label: Fixed, time-aware
splits.detail: Create a split column upstream so validation and test rows occur after the training window.

scenarios.label: Route support tickets
scenarios.detail: Predict the queue that should receive a new ticket. The same customer can open several closely related tickets.
scenarios.splitReason: Keeping one customer in one partition prevents near-duplicate account history from inflating held-out performance.

fields.name: ticket_text
fields.detail: The text submitted with the new ticket.

fields.name: product_area
fields.detail: The product selected when the ticket is opened.

fields.name: resolution_code
fields.detail: Recorded only after the ticket is resolved; it leaks the downstream workflow.

fields.name: analyst_notes
fields.detail: Added during offline review and absent from the live request.

scenarios.label: Predict renewal risk
scenarios.detail: Estimate whether an account will renew in the next 30 days using monthly snapshots.
scenarios.splitReason: A future holdout reveals temporal drift and prevents later snapshots from informing an earlier training example.

fields.name: usage_30d
fields.detail: Usage measured before the prediction cutoff.

fields.name: open_support_cases
fields.detail: Open cases at the prediction cutoff.

fields.name: renewal_invoice_status
fields.detail: Created by the renewal workflow after the prediction cutoff.

fields.name: finance_risk_override
fields.detail: Available in the training export but not in the online feature contract.

scenarios.label: Triage manufacturing defects
scenarios.detail: Classify a newly inspected part when each row represents an independently sampled item.
scenarios.splitReason: Rows are independent samples from the same operating window, so a stratified random partition is a defensible baseline.

fields.name: sensor_vector
fields.detail: Calibrated measurements collected at inspection time.

fields.name: line_id
fields.detail: The production line that made the part.

fields.name: material_lot
fields.detail: The material lot known before classification.

fields.name: rework_action
fields.detail: Chosen after the defect is classified and therefore leaks the outcome.

fields.name: lab_microscopy_code
fields.detail: Produced by a later lab process that the online inspection path cannot call.

notice: This lab validates experiment design, not model quality. Confirm the generated Ludwig configuration against the installed version's schema and measure the trained model on genuinely held-out data.
